idea.titol:
It can all begin
with one small detail.
idea.text: At art.aneris the starting point isn’t only the memory, it’s what it made you feel. The sea, Montserrat, a forest — or even something that keeps resonating inside you.

lloc.text: That landscape or space you’ll always want to go back to.

ruta.text: The day you reached a summit that meant far more than the distance.

momentVital.text: A shared memory you don’t want to be just one more photo: your baby’s tiny hands, your pet’s little paws.

sensacio.text: A colour, a chapter or an emotion you don’t yet know how to put into images.

galeria.altBosc: Textured piece inspired by a forest
galeria.altAbstractaTerracota: Detail of a textured abstract piece in terracotta tones

formes.eyebrow: How do you want to live art.aneris?
formes.titol: One idea. Four ways to make it yours.

encarrecs.text: A memory, a place or a moment turned into a piece created specifically for you.

rutes.titol: I want to immortalise a route
rutes.text: The mountain, the track and the meaning of a day you don’t want to forget, reinterpreted in relief.

regals.titol: I want to capture a life moment
regals.text: First you give the story; then the piece is created with whoever receives it.

cocreacio.titol: I want to make it myself
cocreacio.text: Learn the technique and create a piece of your own — no identical templates.

proces.titol: Art you have a story to tell about.

partida.cita: It’s our anniversary and I want to give her a little piece of the sea — she always goes there with our dog Meeko when she needs quiet and a break from the noise of everyday life.
partida.peu: You tell me what’s behind it: what happened, why it matters and what you don’t want to lose over time.

interpretacio.alt: Detail with footprints on a textured piece inspired by the sea
interpretacio.peu: I look for a composition that keeps the emotion without spelling it out: silhouettes, layers, strokes, paths and textures.

obra.alt: Living room with a textured art.aneris sea piece
obra.peu: The memory stops being an image saved on your phone and becomes a piece with a place in your home.

rutes.eyebrow: The line that sets it apart
rutes.titol: Some routes last far longer than the day you walk them.
rutes.text: Send me a Strava route, a summit or a walk that mattered. The track, the profile of the mountain and what that day meant to you become a one-of-a-kind piece.
rutes.nota: The route stops being data inside an app and becomes part of your home.

pas1.peu: The original track that sets the piece in motion.
pas1.alt: Map with the original route track

pas2.peu: The route turns into form, volume and landscape.
pas2.alt: Interpretation of the relief and the landscape from the route

pas3.peu: The story ends up as a piece for your home.
pas3.alt: Finished textured piece inspired by the route

rutes.segell: The story carries on, on your wall

empremtes.titol: Some memories begin with a print.
empremtes.text: The Empremtes collection exists to keep what is so often small, fragile and immense all at once: a baby’s tiny hands and feet, or the paws of a dog or a cat that are part of your story.
empremtes.nota: The print is worked into the piece so the memory lasts.

pas1.peu: The real mark of tiny hands, little feet or paws.

pas2.peu: The print is worked into the piece, delicate and organic.

pas3.peu: The memory takes on body and presence.

tallers.titol: You won’t come to copy the same painting as everyone else.
tallers.text: In every workshop you learn the technique, but the piece is yours. Different compositions, textures and colours, so you leave with a work that really has a place in your home.
tallers.nota: No previous experience needed. I’m there with you so you can make your own creative decisions instead of freezing in front of a blank canvas.

tallers.altPecaProces: Textured piece in progress in terracotta tones

ideaClara.questio: Do I need to know exactly how I want the piece?
ideaClara.resposta: No. You can come with just a story, a photo, a route or a feeling. Part of the process is precisely finding the way to turn that into a visual proposal.

strava.questio: Can I have a piece made from a Strava route?
strava.resposta: Yes. You can send a screenshot or the route data. The track is the starting point for building the relief and connecting it to the landscape, the summit or the story of that day.

regal.questio: Can I gift a piece without deciding it for the other person?
regal.resposta: Yes. The two-step gift lets you give the intention and the experience first. The piece is then built with the person who will receive it.

tallers.questio: Are the workshops only for experienced people?
tallers.resposta: No previous experience needed. You’ll learn the technique and be guided through the process, but the creative decisions and the final piece will be yours.

peu.lema: Textured art that turns memories, places, routes and life moments into pieces with meaning.
